name: OpenArena
hint: Free Quake III-style arena shooter server, joined over IPv6

SERVER_NAME.title: Server name
SERVER_NAME.description: Players join from Multiplayer, Specify with the app's address and port 27960, or type /connect followed by the address in the console. The address is IPv6-only, so players need IPv6 on their network.

START_MAP.title: Start map
START_MAP.description: The server moves on to other maps after each match, and players can vote to change the map or game type.

BOTS.title: Bots
BOTS.description: Bots join until the arena has this many players, and leave as people arrive.

SERVER_PASSWORD.title: Server password
SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Leave empty for an open server.

RCON_PASSWORD.title: RCON password
RCON_PASSWORD.description: For remote admin: /rconpassword followed by this password, then /rcon commands in the console.
